# City Research Online

> > City Research Online is an open access institutional repository showcasing research publications, doctoral theses, and scholarly works from City, University of London and its constituent schools.

City Research Online provides comprehensive access to research outputs from City's five schools including Bayes Business School, The City Law School, School of Communication & Creativity, School of Health & Medical Sciences, and School of Science & Technology. The repository supports open access initiatives, research preservation, and REF compliance for the institution.

## Getting Started

- [Welcome to City Research Online](https://openaccess.city.ac.uk): Homepage for City Research Online institutional repository
- [About City Research Online](https://openaccess.city.ac.uk/information.html): About City Research Online open access repository
- [Repository Policies](https://openaccess.city.ac.uk/policies.html): Repository policies for metadata, copyright, and preservation

## Browse Research

- [Browse by Year](https://openaccess.city.ac.uk/view/year): Browse City Research Online publications chronologically by year
- [Browse by Subject](https://openaccess.city.ac.uk/view/subjects): Browse research by Library of Congress subject classification
- [Browse Schools and Departments](https://openaccess.city.ac.uk/view/divisions): Browse research by institutional schools and departments
- [Browse Schools and Departments by Authors](https://openaccess.city.ac.uk/view/divisions2): Browse schools/departments with author listings
- [Latest Additions](https://openaccess.city.ac.uk/cgi/latest_tool): Latest 20 recent additions to City Research Online

## Author Directory

- [Browse by Author](https://openaccess.city.ac.uk/view/creators): Alphabetical index of City Research Online authors
- [Browse by City Author](https://openaccess.city.ac.uk/view/creators_id): Browse research by City University authors with ID listing

## School Collections

- [Bayes Business School](https://openaccess.city.ac.uk/view/divisions/BBBSCH): Browse Bayes Business School research by publication year
- [The City Law School](https://openaccess.city.ac.uk/view/divisions/LLILAW): Browse City Law School research by publication year
- [School of Communication & Creativity](https://openaccess.city.ac.uk/view/divisions/SCOMCR): Browse School of Communication & Creativity research by year
- [School of Health & Medical Sciences](https://openaccess.city.ac.uk/view/divisions/HSSOHS): Browse School of Health & Medical Sciences research by year
- [School of Science & Technology](https://openaccess.city.ac.uk/view/divisions/EEMCSE): Browse School of Science & Technology research by year
- [School of Policy & Global Affairs](https://openaccess.city.ac.uk/view/divisions/GPOLGA): Browse School of Policy & Global Affairs research by year
